p. 99 row 3 – p. 103 row 3: Budge's “Appendix.” — Chapter XXIX A (Naville, Todtenbuch Bd. I Bl. 40, p. 99 n. 1), Chapter XXX A (Naville Bd. I Bl. 42, p. 100 n. 1) and Chapter XXVIII (Naville Bd. I Bl. 39, p. 101 n. 2), with the footnote p. 101 n. 1 (a variant of ḥenka) — not Ani's text; his Table of Chapters brackets [XXIX A], [XXX A], [XXVIII] as supplied
sections: Two stretches of print, four chapters: XXIX (p. 96 last row – p. 97 row 5, ll. 1–3) and XXVII (p. 97 row 6 – p. 99 row 2, ll. 1–6; the “PLATE XVI.” heading on p. 97 falls in its l. 1–2: words above it are Plate XV); then LVIII (p. 103 from the overlined title below the rule – p. 104 row 6, ll. 1–7, with its closing rubric “àr reχ re pen …”) and LIX (p. 104 row 7 – p. 105 row 3, ll. 1–4). Budge's numerals restart at 1 in each chapter; a numeral printed inside a word group (LVIII 2., 5., 7.) leaves the word in the line in force at its first sign. Every word carries “chapter”.
